notes.title: Chef's Update
notes.notes:
I finally got around to work on this again - plans are always changing I know :D

But today I bring you:
* A new Song
* Fixed frogs

I think you all remember the frogs sitting on top of you and slowly killing you?
Well that is gone now - you are welcome.

Also I will update the stores page to add a discord again :) 

if the update doesn't show up for you: Try to repair the game files and make sure you are not using the beta branches.

Currently the discord is not that active - I try to make it more active.

notes.title: Development continues
notes.notes:
Well happy new year and so forth - hopefully you all are alright.

The development of Chef's Adventure will continue slow and steady with at least one stream per week.

[url=twitch.tv/wafobi]Check it out[/url]

notes.title: Moving the release to the future
notes.notes: Good things happen all the time - therefore I am currently busy with other things and this pet project will go into hiatus for an unknown time.

notes.title: The Demo is done
notes.notes:
Enjoy the small demo of Chef's Adventure.
I will go ahead an start working on the remaining levels.

Enjoy and have fun.

notes.title: Release updates
notes.notes:
I simply can't reliably release for macOS under the current terms and conditions.
There is currently some bug either in macOS or Godot that prevents running this game.

Additionally I would be breaking Apples Terms and Conditions if I don't pay Money to Apple.
Therefore macOS releases will be discontinued so that I can realize this game.

notes.title: Reworked the doors
notes.notes:
I spend the better part of my evening reworking this.
Enjoy the doors and some code optimization.

Next up:
Graphical improvements for the Demo and more sound improvements.

notes.title: A new month - a new Chef version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874204/d4fe74cf385152ee058b929fe8c9082a083dcfb0.png[/img]

The default font I used got boring, therefore I searched for a new font and I found [url=https://caffinate.itch.io/fibberish]fibberish[/url]. A nice pixelart Font I like.

Added features:
[list]
[*] Improved jump and walking
[*] Game doesn't require Steam to be online anymore.
[*] Steamdeck Support (and general better controller support added)
[*] a death animation for the chef
[*] instand glyph updates when switching form  controller to keyboard or other way around
[*] Level in Transition screen
[/list]

Bug fixes:
[list]
[*] Chef not able to finish first and last level because it couldn't jump high enough
[*] Fixed wrongly formatted text - should look better now
[*] You can't open the menu in the level end-screen anymore
[/list]

I am getting ready to start working on the full version now. I will fix the remaining bugs and the sometime this month there will be an end to demo development so that I can focus on the main game.


Visit the Chef's Discord for more. You can even write bug-reports there.
[url=https://discord.gg/XDzQG9kXhu][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874204/c9a827d0929aa91d7bf4dc204aaefc17d3923a2b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Controller, Animations and better steering
notes.notes:
Now the big chunk of an update is here.
Took two month but here we are.

Added controller support ( all three types hopefully correctly ) can't change the mapping for now but that will be something for the future.

Also paralax background in two of three levels.

Enjoy and keep jumping.

notes.title: Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
A small intermediate release for the Demo. Expect more to come until July - then it's Steam Fest time! 

[list]
[*] Resetting your custom keymap should now work properly
[*] Better Audio Settings
[*] Overall smoother look and feel.
[/list]

notes.title: New Features
notes.notes:
It took a while to get to get all of this going.
Now there is a steam integration in the game, which means that there will be achievements soon!!

Ah yes and a better key remap UI :)

notes.title: Chef's Adventure
notes.notes:
The Demo was released today. In several small increments I got it to where it needs to be for this page.

The next big update will bring controller support and button customization to the demo. As well as Steam Integration with Archievements. 

Enjoy.
